title: Phase evolution, mechanical properties, and corrosion resistance of Ti2NbVAl0.3Zrx lightweight refractory high-entropy alloys
process_description: prepared by vacuum arc melting furnace under the protection of high-purity argon gas using metal particles with purity >99.95% as raw materials. Ti-Al and Zr-V-Nb intermediate alloys were prepared first to avoid melting losses and segregation, then combined and melted six times repeatedly. Before melting, the chamber was evacuated to 3×10⁻³ Pa and purged five times with high-purity argon gas.
